Create two synthetic accounts and select two distinct profiles in a fresh scratch org. Substitute their IDs for the placeholders in the provider metadata files and deploy three synthetic Salesforce-managed providers without initiating authentication. Update the FlowDefaultAccountId of two providers through the data API using the synthetic accounts. At API 67.0, require one saved null and two distinct populated IDs for each field before recording each ORDER BY variant. Both fields are absent from API 62.0 describe in nulls_order_remaining_lookup/org.tsv.
